articles.title: Install on Mac
articles.body:
# Install on Mac

Open the Shield app from Applications. It stays in the Dock and shows the dashboard at https://memetorrent.futuret3ch.com.au/shield.

Self-heal, Refresh, Guide, and the cog are in the **top right** on every page.

Live grid and live tracking are core features, not add-ons.

articles.title: Install on Windows
articles.body:
# Install on Windows

Windows Shield uses the same account and license as Mac. The Windows service runs scans (ClamAV + Defender complement). It is not a kernel rootkit.

Download from https://memetorrent.futuret3ch.com.au/shield when the Windows build is published.

articles.title: Install on iPhone
articles.body:
# Install on iPhone

iPhone Shield is a **companion**: Guide, Family Link, lock-down checklists, local-network list.

It does **not** scan the whole iPhone disk. Apple does not allow a full background antivirus. We will not fake that screen.

articles.title: Install on Android
articles.body:
# Install on Android

Android Shield can on-demand scan APKs/files, show hotspot clients, and panic-lock sharing. Same login as Mac.

No invented device list. What you see is from this phone.

articles.title: Install the browser extension
articles.body:
# Install the browser extension

The extension checks links and phishing and opens Guide. It does not intercept your operating system and does not pretend to scan the whole disk.

articles.title: Sign in (Google, Facebook, or email)
articles.body:
# Sign in (Google, Facebook, or email)

Use Google, Facebook, or email + password. Your profile picture from Google or Facebook shows next to the cog.

The Mac app talks to https://memetorrent.futuret3ch.com.au/shield/api. Secrets are not stored in the local dashboard.

articles.title: Start the 14-day trial
articles.body:
# Start the 14-day trial

Trial is **14 days**, full Pro plus all five add-ons, starting at first sign-in.

After that: Free (masked live data) or Pro at $30/month or $250/year.

The countdown is in the top right. We do not invent extra trial days on screen.

articles.title: First scan
articles.body:
# First scan

On Mac/Windows, Run shield scan uses real ClamAV signatures plus Shield’s stalkerware/remote-access checks.

iPhone will not show a fake “scanning all files” bar.

articles.title: Free vs Pro vs add-ons
articles.body:
# Free vs Pro vs add-ons

**Free:** real dashboard with watermark; grid/map blurred (real dots, IPs hidden); 1 scan/day.

**Pro ($30/mo or $250/yr):** live grid, live tracking, Street on the selected pin, sharing lock, evidence, Guide unlimited.

**Add-ons:** Realtime AV, Network Ops (extra intercept), Family Link, Breach Watch, Concierge. Grid and live map are **not** add-ons.

articles.title: Mac Full Disk Access (optional, real)
articles.body:
# Mac Full Disk Access (optional, real)

Full Disk Access is a real macOS permission so ClamAV can read more files. It is optional.

iPhone and the browser extension never ask for “full disk” and never animate a fake full-disk scan.

articles.title: Start at login
articles.body:
# Start at login

Shield should start when you log in so Self-heal can restart dead agents. Toggle this in Settings → General when the cloud account ships; local agents already KeepAlive on this Mac.

articles.title: Uninstall
articles.body:
# Uninstall

Mac: quit Shield, remove the app, and unload LaunchAgents that belong to Shield. Help → Contact if a leftover agent remains.

Do not delete other Futuret3ch APIs on Contabo while uninstalling the Mac app.

articles.title: Dashboard
articles.body:
# Dashboard

Status of this device, agents, and alerts. Top right: Self-heal, Refresh, Guide, cog, avatar.

articles.title: Virus scanner
articles.body:
# Virus scanner

ClamAV on Mac/Windows. Real signatures. Quarantine + restore. iPhone is not a fake AV.

articles.title: Advanced scanner settings
articles.body:
# Advanced scanner settings

Max file size, archive depth, excludes, CPU cap, USB scan. Realtime AV add-on required for on-access scan.

articles.title: Downloads guard
articles.body:
# Downloads guard

Watches the Downloads folder for new droppers. This is on-device, not a cloud spy.

articles.title: Self-heal
articles.body:
# Self-heal

Top right. Restarts dead Shield agents. Does not attack other machines.

articles.title: Sharing lock
articles.body:
# Sharing lock

Turns off SSH/VNC/SMB style sharing listeners on this device.

articles.title: AirDrop / Handoff
articles.body:
# AirDrop / Handoff

awdl0 is this device’s AirDrop radio, not another phone. You can switch it off.

articles.title: P2P block
articles.body:
# P2P block

Stops torrent/P2P tools on this device. Not a network attack.

articles.title: Defense Network Grid
articles.body:
# Defense Network Grid

Core Pro. Live path: this device, hotspot, LAN peers, remotes. utun×3 is Apple iCloud on THIS Mac.

articles.title: Live map and Street
articles.body:
# Live map and Street

Core Pro. Click a **dot**, then **Street** — that pin, not yours. IP geo is city-level, not GPS on a person.

articles.title: Master Block
articles.body:
# Master Block

Freeze a baseline of login items and quarantine new unknown agents.

articles.title: Certificates / proxy watch
articles.body:
# Certificates / proxy watch

Looks for unexpected proxies and certificates on this device.

articles.title: Threat / stalkerware scan
articles.body:
# Threat / stalkerware scan

Known remote-access and stalkerware names on this device. Not a guarantee.

articles.title: Evidence vault
articles.body:
# Evidence vault

Screenshots and reports stored on this Mac. Export for police or a lawyer. We do not publish them.

articles.title: Firewall / listeners
articles.body:
# Firewall / listeners

Shows what is listening. Odd remote ports are flagged. Real lsof data.

articles.title: Login items / LaunchAgents
articles.body:
# Login items / LaunchAgents

Audit of what starts at login. Unknown agents can be quarantined.

articles.title: Account and avatar
articles.body:
# Account and avatar

Google/Facebook/email. Picture sits next to the cog.

14-day trial, then $30/mo or $250/yr via Stripe on the Shield hub.

articles.title: Shield Guide AI
articles.body:
# Shield Guide AI

Explains live status. Customizes to threat level. Refuses attack advice.

articles.title: Threat levels and devices
articles.body:
# Threat levels and devices

Everyday, Elevated, Stalking, Child/teen. Child mode always shows a visible guardian link.

articles.title: If you think you are being stalked
articles.body:
# If you think you are being stalked

Set threat level to Stalking. Lock sharing and AirDrop. Export evidence. Contact local emergency services if you are in danger. Shield cannot catch a person.

articles.title: Stalkerware: what it is
articles.body:
# Stalkerware: what it is

Hidden apps that report location or messages. Shield looks for known names on THIS device. A clean scan does not prove nobody has your cloud passwords.

articles.title: Hotspot: who is actually on it
articles.body:
# Hotspot: who is actually on it

Only devices that joined the hotspot Wi-Fi show as LAN peers. A second phone in the car is invisible until it joins. utun/awdl are this computer.

articles.title: Preserve evidence
articles.body:
# Preserve evidence

Use the evidence vault. Do not hack back. Do not install counter-spyware. That can break a case and is out of scope.

articles.title: Child / teen mode
articles.body:
# Child / teen mode

Simple language. No scare copy. Always show Linked to [guardian]. Child can Unlink.

articles.title: Guardian link
articles.body:
# Guardian link

Family Link add-on: code on the adult device, typed on the child device. Location Share defaults off.

articles.title: What Shield will never do
articles.body:
# What Shield will never do

No hacking back, no silent GPS, no hidden parent spy, no fake full-disk iPhone scan, no invented IPs.

articles.title: Talking to police / a hotline
articles.body:
# Talking to police / a hotline

Export diagnostics. We are not emergency services. Add real hotline numbers per country in Head Office later.

articles.title: Workplace harassment on a shared Mac
articles.body:
# Workplace harassment on a shared Mac

Elevated level, sharing off, freeze a baseline. Talk to HR or legal as well as using Shield.

articles.title: Panic lock
articles.body:
# Panic lock

One control to turn sharing, AirDrop, and odd listen ports off. Use Self-heal after.

articles.title: Realtime AV
articles.body:
# Realtime AV

On-access ClamAV on Mac/Windows. $8/mo. Not available as a fake iOS disk scanner.

articles.title: Network Ops
articles.body:
# Network Ops

Extra intercept and neighbor-join alerts. $8/mo. Grid and live map are already Pro.

articles.title: Family Link
articles.body:
# Family Link

Parental controls, visible kid link, opt-in location. $8/mo. Child can unlink.

articles.title: Breach Watch
articles.body:
# Breach Watch

Email/phone breach alerts. $5/mo. Cloud, all clients.

articles.title: Concierge Support
articles.body:
# Concierge Support

Priority tickets and consented remote help. $10/mo. No silent remote desktop.

Guardian taps Create code. Child types it or opens the link. Both screens show Linked to …

articles.title: What the child sees
articles.body:
# What the child sees

A persistent banner: Linked to [name]. Unlink is always available. No hidden icon.

articles.title: Location Share (opt-in)
articles.body:
# Location Share (opt-in)

Defaults off. The child (or the child’s device) turns it on. Not silent GPS.

articles.title: Unlink / bedtime / panic lock
articles.body:
# Unlink / bedtime / panic lock

Child or guardian can unlink. Bedtime downtime and panic lock are parental controls, visible on the child device.
